description: GET /api/stock-records returns a bare JSON array containing exactly the three seeded records (WID-001/A-01/12, BOLT-07/A-01/40, WID-001/B-02/3), each with id, sku, location, quantity and tracking_code, using per-run-unique SKUs/locations
GET /api/stock-records returns records ordered by location then sku, so records at the same location are adjacent
